title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling with Multi-Sequence Verifiers
authors_zh: Yegon Kim、Seungyoo Lee、Chaeyun Jang、Hyungi Lee、Juho Lee（机构以官方论文为准）
paper_type_zh: 集合级验证器与并行测试时扩展论文
best_for_zh: 优化并行候选选择和时延预算的读者。
one_line: MSV jointly scores parallel candidates to improve best-of-N selection and reduce latency through streaming early stopping.
MSV 联合为并行候选打分，以改善 best-of-N 选择并通过流式提前停止降低时延。
why: It treats interactions among candidates as evidence for verifier scaling.
inclusion_reason: It makes set-level verifier calibration and parallel early stopping explicit test-time scaling variables.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel test-time scaling normally generates several candidate solutions and scores them one by one. That wastes a potentially useful signal: candidates in the same pool can agree, contradict one another, or reveal that a seemingly plausible answer is an outlier.

The paper asks whether a verifier should observe the candidate set jointly and whether it can stop decoding before every parallel sequence finishes. The target is better selection at a fixed latency budget, rather than an accuracy gain obtained by quietly waiting for more completed answers.

并行测试时扩展通常生成多个候选解，并逐个为它们评分。这浪费了一个可能有用的信号：同一候选池中的答案可以彼此一致、相互矛盾，或显示一个看似合理的回答其实是离群值。

本文研究验证器是否应联合观察候选集合，以及它能否在每个并行序列完成前停止解码。目标是在固定时延预算下得到更好的选择，而不是通过暗中等待更多完整答案来换取准确率提升。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
A Multi-Sequence Verifier scores a set of parallel candidates together rather than treating every sequence as independent evidence. The joint view lets the verifier condition a candidate’s score on how other attempts support, duplicate, or challenge its reasoning and answer.

The authors also make this joint scorer usable during generation. A streaming version updates the decision as partial sequences arrive and can terminate the remaining work once the selected answer is sufficiently stable, coupling the selection rule to an explicit latency decision.

多序列验证器联合为一组并行候选评分，而不是把每个序列当成独立证据。联合视角让验证器能够根据其他尝试如何支持、重复或质疑某个候选的推理和答案，来调整该候选的分数。

作者还让这个联合评分器能够在生成过程中使用。流式版本会随着部分序列到达而更新决定，并能在选中的答案足够稳定时终止剩余工作，从而把选择规则与明确的时延决策连接起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
The model receives a prompt and a parallel set of candidate trajectories, then predicts scores while modeling interactions across sequences. Candidates are ranked by these set-conditioned scores instead of isolated verifier scores. For streaming inference, the same information is refreshed as decoding progresses and a stopping criterion determines whether unfinished candidates still merit computation.

Evaluation compares set-level and isolated verification for best-of-N selection, calibration, and latency. The relevant trace contains the candidate pool, decoding times, intermediate and final joint scores, stop time, chosen answer, and task outcome; otherwise an early-stopping result cannot be audited against a full-decoding baseline.

模型接收一个提示和一组并行候选轨迹，再在建模序列间交互的同时预测分数。候选由这些集合条件分数排序，而不是由孤立验证器分数排序。对于流式推理，同一信息会随解码推进而更新，停止准则决定未完成候选是否仍值得继续消耗计算。

评估比较集合级和孤立验证在最佳候选选择、校准和时延上的表现。相关轨迹应包含候选池、解码时间、中间和最终联合分数、停止时刻、选择的回答和任务结果；否则，提前停止结果无法相对于完整解码基线进行审计。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports improved calibration and best-of-N selection relative to isolated scoring. Its streaming variant reaches a stated target accuracy with roughly half the latency of the isolated-verifier counterpart, supporting the claim that set-level evidence can be useful before all parallel generations end.

The evidence is about the tested candidate distributions and parallel serving setup. A speedup must be interpreted with the cost of joint scoring, synchronization, and cancelled sequences included; an accuracy–latency curve is more informative than one number because the appropriate stopping point depends on the product constraint.

论文报告，相比孤立评分，该方法具有更好的校准和最佳候选选择表现。其流式变体以孤立验证器对应方法约一半的时延达到设定目标准确率，支持集合级证据在所有并行生成结束前就可能有用的主张。

这些证据针对被测试的候选分布和并行服务设置。解释加速时必须计入联合评分、同步和被取消序列的成本；准确率—时延曲线比单个数字更有信息，因为合适的停止点取决于产品约束。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most verifier pipelines assign a scalar score to one candidate at a time and aggregate only after scoring is complete. This paper moves the interaction into the verifier itself: a candidate is judged in the context of its peer candidates, and that context can affect both ranking and the decision to stop generation.

The contribution is therefore a change in the unit of verification, from an individual trajectory to a candidate set. It is distinct from simply adding more samples or more verifier calls, because the proposed signal is the relation among concurrently generated attempts.

大多数验证流程一次给一个候选分配标量分数，并只在评分完成后聚合。本文把交互移入验证器本身：候选在其同伴候选的上下文中被判断，这一上下文可以同时影响排序和停止生成的决定。

因此，贡献在于改变验证的单位，从单条轨迹变成候选集合。它不同于简单增加样本或验证器调用，因为所提出的信号是并发生成尝试之间的关系。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Joint verification may become costly as candidate sets grow and can be brittle when the pool is highly correlated or contains inconsistent formatting. A set-trained verifier may also be calibrated for one sampling temperature, model family, or parallel width but not another. Streaming cancellation risks cutting off a late correct solution, especially under distribution shift. Users should measure wall-clock latency, scorer cost, cancellation overhead, and accuracy separately for every parallel width rather than interpreting a reported speedup as architecture-independent.
随着候选集合变大，联合验证可能变得昂贵；当候选池高度相关或格式不一致时，它也可能脆弱。集合训练的验证器还可能只针对某一采样温度、模型家族或并行宽度校准，而不适用于其他情况。流式取消存在截断较晚出现的正确解的风险，尤其是在分布发生变化时。用户应针对每个并行宽度分别测量真实时延、评分器成本、取消开销和准确率，而不能把报告的加速理解为与架构无关。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when an application already generates several candidates in parallel and the bottleneck is selection latency. Compare it with an isolated verifier using exactly the same candidate generator, maximum parallel width, and final-answer evaluator, then plot quality as a function of elapsed time and completed tokens. It is especially relevant when diversity among candidates is expected to be informative. It is less compelling when the system emits only one candidate, when joint scoring cannot fit the latency envelope, or when a reliable external verifier already makes cross-candidate reasoning unnecessary.
当应用已经并行生成多个候选，而瓶颈是选择时延时，可以使用本文。应在完全相同的候选生成器、最大并行宽度和最终答案评估器下与孤立验证器比较，再把质量画成经过时间和已完成 token 数的函数。当候选之间的多样性预计具有信息量时，它尤其相关。如果系统只输出一个候选、联合评分无法满足时延范围，或可靠的外部验证器已经使跨候选推理没有必要，它就不太有说服力。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The main reading point is that parallel samples are not automatically independent votes. Inspect how the paper represents candidate interactions and whether the improvement survives when candidate diversity, decoding width, and stopping threshold change. Report unfinished work explicitly: a cancelled sequence still consumed some compute, and a joint verifier may serialize a supposedly parallel pipeline. The strongest reproduction checks compare full completion and early stopping at matched quality, then disclose both token cost and end-to-end wall-clock latency.
主要的阅读要点是，并行样本并不会自动成为独立投票。应检查论文如何表示候选交互，以及当候选多样性、解码宽度和停止阈值变化时，改进是否仍然存在。必须明确报告未完成工作：被取消的序列仍然消耗了一些计算，联合验证器也可能让本应并行的流程串行化。最严格的复现检查是在匹配质量下比较完整完成和提前停止，然后同时披露 token 成本和端到端真实时延。
